package v1

import (
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

func NewRouter(handler handlers.CoursePlanHandler, bootstrap ...handlers.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapHandler) chi.Router {
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.RequireStudent)
	router.Post("/course-plans", handler.CreateCoursePlan)
	router.Get("/course-plans/{requestID}", handler.GetCoursePlan)
	if len(bootstrap) == 1 {
		router.Post("/diagnostic-assessment-plans", bootstrap[0].Start)
	}
	return router
}
